mapper.insert: insert into clazz (name, room, begin_date, end_date, master_id, subject, create_time, update_time) values (#{name}, #{room}, #{beginDate}, #{endDate}, #{masterId}, #{subject}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update:
update clazz
name = #{name},
room = #{room},
begin_date = #{beginDate},
end_date = #{endDate},
master_id = #{masterId},
subject = #{subject},
update_time = #{updateTime},
where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select c.id,c.name,c.room,c.begin_date,c.end_date,e.id as master_id,c.subject, c.create_time, c.update_time from clazz c left join emp e on c.master_id=e.id where c.id=#{id}
